meta.name: ai-amazon-search-optimization
meta.description: Amazon 搜索优化助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“买家搜得到吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 诊断商品搜索表现并生成优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营亚马逊商品，需要提升搜索可见性
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose product search performance and generate optimization suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Amazon listings and need to improve search visibility

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Amazon 搜索优化助手。它能根据你提供的商品信息、关键词或链接，生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。
howto.when: 当你问“买家搜得到吗”这类问题，或需要分析 Amazon 商品/店铺的搜索表现时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个商品链接的搜索可见性。
say.note: Claude 会读取链接并给出诊断和建议。

say.text: 我的产品关键词是“无线耳机”，目标市场美国，请给出优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会结合关键词和目标市场输出运营动作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an Amazon search optimization assistant. It can generate product/store diagnostics, selling points, risk alerts, and operational action suggestions based on provided product info, keywords, or links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'Can buyers find my product?' or need to analyze Amazon product/store search performance.

say_en.text: Analyze the search visibility of this product link.
say_en.note: Claude will read the link and provide diagnostics.

say_en.text: My product keyword is 'wireless earbuds', target market US. Give optimization suggestions.
say_en.note: Claude will output operational actions based on keyword and target market.
